answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only identified option that independently meets the mandated 18% spend reduction before the non-renewing contract expires. However, at 94% committed assembly volume, historical evidence of quick onboarding and accurate invoicing does not establish current delivery capacity, quality performance, or continuity risk. Verify the prior switch record and second-source shortage record before committing; proceed only with confirmed capacity, delivery controls, and a transition contingency.
